intent: Two review concepts only. Approved source art, data and scenes are unchanged.

prompts.Warrior:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: revised Warrior full-body concept, one original game character on transparent background.
Input image 1 is the current Warrior to redesign. Image 2 is the approved Rogue: reference ONLY for the exact angular cartoon drawing language, proportions, economical detail and muted color treatment; do not borrow its costume.
Keep the same approved art direction: confident heavy near-black irregular outlines, sharp simplified shapes, large clean flat cel-shadow planes, muted iron grey / olive / leather brown / small ochre accents. About 5.5–6 adult heads tall, broad expressive hands and substantial boots. Crisp polished drawing, no gradients, glow, painterly grain, dithering, tiny texture or glossy anime rendering. Do not lower the image resolution or turn it into coarse pixel art.
Redesign the Warrior as a recognizable sturdy, earnest, slightly stubborn beginning adventurer, with all of his face covered by a practical iron helmet. His individuality comes from a squat broad-brimmed angular helmet with a strong low brow and a blunt closed jaw guard; the dark narrow visor reads like a determined expression, no visible human eyes or skin. Modest functional armor, not a decorated legendary knight.
Remove the entire ragged shoulder mantle, scarf and hanging cloth strips that currently make him look like the Rogue. Give him a short ochre padded arming jacket visible at elbows and beneath a plain slightly rounded iron breastplate, sturdy practical shoulder plates, leather gloves, plain belt and compact iron knee/shin protection over dark trousers. Use a few broad armor shapes rather than many tiny overlapping parts. No hood, cape, tabard, long fabric accessory, fur, gold trim, crest, rune or trophy.
Keep the simple broad one-handed iron sword and plain wooden shield, without extra equipment. A modest asymmetry between sword-arm protection and the sturdier shield shoulder gives the armor a memorable silhouette. Warm approachable stouthearted body language, shoulders square and shield held confidently near him; full three-quarter view, head looking in the same direction as his torso. He is a human adult, not a dwarf, robot, or chibi.
One single complete character only, standing with both boots visible, generous clear margin around sword, shield and helmet. Full-color native portrait illustration on genuinely transparent background. No ground shadow, halo, backdrop, text, labels, signature or watermark. Match the approved references' visual quality and restrained level of detail.
prompts.Barbarian:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: revised Barbarian full-body game character concept.
Input image 1 is the edit target: approved muscular lizard Barbarian. The user specifically LOVES the existing head and entire upper body. PRESERVE his original head shape, facial identity, expression, horn shapes, olive-ochre scales, pale throat and chest, broad muscular anatomy, black open sleeveless vest, arm wraps, hands, axe, pose and upper-body drawing essentially unchanged. Do not redesign the upper body.
Change only the lower-body costume beginning at his waist, so he no longer resembles a Samurai in a wrapped robe and long sash. Remove the rust-red wrapped sash, long dangling cloth panel, and layered ragged fabric skirt. Replace them with a single wide plain dark brown leather belt with a small functional iron buckle, and rugged charcoal-brown cropped leather trousers ending above the knees. Give the trousers broad simple shapes and a clean bold silhouette, very few seams and no pockets or decorations. Preserve his thick reptilian tail, original powerful digitigrade lower legs, bare clawed feet, and simple existing ankle wraps. Keep the belt compact; no cloth streamers, loincloth, skirt, robe, cape, trophy, hanging accessory or Samurai-style garment. The distinction comes from the lizard's exposed muscular body and compact tough workwear, not extra ornament.
Preserve the exact approved angular cartoon illustration style: thick near-black outlines, big flat sharp-edged cel-shading shapes, restrained muted earthy colors, clean economical detail. Maintain original composition, proportions, scale, colors, lighting and all untouched elements. No smooth gradient, glow, small texture, grain, dithering, glossy rendering or coarse pixelation. Full body including the complete original axe and feet, native portrait canvas with comfortable margins.
One character only, genuine transparent background, no halo, ground shadow, text, label, signature or watermark. Upper body identity preservation is the highest priority.
